title: Architettura — Corporate Knowledge Assistant
summary: System architecture of the Corporate Knowledge Assistant: three domain services, ingestion and query pipelines, data ownership on PostgreSQL, ports/adapters extensibility, and open decisions.
notes: Manifest-declared SPEC. Document contains a 'Decisioni aperte' section listing unresolved choices (object storage S3 vs bytea, NoOp cache vs Redis, parser/OCR/embedding/LLM selection, Docker vs Podman, OpenAPI contract-first vs generated from Rust); these are open, not locked. Output filename uses a path-derived suffix instead of the SHA-256 source hash because no shell/hash tool was available to this classifier.
